description: External-app build (lite track) for a repo outside HQ (e.g. A l Oreille): branch studio/{{slug}} from origin/main in {{workdir}} → spec+UX (local, written into the app repo docs/specs) → design (Opus) → owner gate → per milestone: build (local, agent from design.md Team: line) → QA (local; checks: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint:baseline) → review (Opus) → push + open PR labelled owner-review (no merge stage) → owner ship gate: review and merge the PR, then publish via Sites. Specs live in the app repo. Vars: workdir (app checkout), slug, idea (intake file, path relative to workdir).

stages.run: git fetch origin && git switch -c studio/{{slug}} origin/main || (echo branch switch failed - does studio/{{slug}} already exist? delete it or use a new slug && exit 1)

stages.task: Lite track. Write {{workdir}}/docs/specs/{{slug}}.md (spec + UX section) from the idea file {{workdir}}/{{idea}}.
Lite track. Write the one-page {{workdir}}/docs/specs/{{slug}}.design.md for {{workdir}}/docs/specs/{{slug}}.md. Use headings exactly '## Milestone N: <name>' for each milestone.

stages.title: {{slug}}: approve spec + design (answer open questions in the spec first)

stages.task: Implement '{{item}}' from {{workdir}}/docs/specs/{{slug}}.design.md (only that milestone). Use the Team role named in design.md; follow its rules. Run lint/typecheck/tests before finishing.
stages.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint:baseline

stages.task: QA '{{item}}' of {{slug}}: only the tasks and 'Try it' of that milestone in {{workdir}}/docs/specs/{{slug}}.design.md, checked against the matching acceptance criteria in {{workdir}}/docs/specs/{{slug}}.md. Follow your 'Pipeline runs' protocol (report file first). Write {{workdir}}/docs/specs/{{slug}}.qa-m{{n}}.md ending with a line 'VERDICT: PASS' or 'VERDICT: FAIL'.
stages.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint:baseline && node -e "if(!/VERDICT:[\s*_\x60]*PASS/.test(require('fs').readFileSync('{{workdir}}/docs/specs/{{slug}}.qa-m{{n}}.md','utf8')))process.exit(1)"

stages.task: Review the whole diff for '{{item}}' of {{slug}}. Write {{workdir}}/docs/specs/{{slug}}.review-m{{n}}.md ending with 'APPROVE' or 'REQUEST CHANGES'.

stages.run: node -e "const c=require('child_process');const r=(a)=>c.spawnSync('git',a,{stdio:'inherit'});r(['add','docs/specs']);if(r(['diff','--cached','--quiet']).status!==0&&r(['commit','-m','docs: {{slug}} spec and reviews']).status!==0)process.exit(1)" && git push -u origin studio/{{slug}} && gh pr create --base main --label owner-review --fill

stages.title: {{slug}}: PR opened (label owner-review). Owner: review and merge the PR, then publish via Sites.
